from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Data from storyboard
        title_text = "The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus (FTC)"
        lecture_lines = [
            "- This is the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.",
            "- To integrate, just find the antiderivative.",
            "- Evaluate it at the two boundaries.",
            "- Subtract the start from the end.",
            "- No more complex Riemann sums needed."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        GOLD = "#FFD700"
        ALTITUDE_COLOR = "#ADD8E6"  # Light Blue
        AREA_COLOR = "#90EE90"      # Light Green
        CURVE_COLOR = "#FFA500"     # Orange
        RIEMANN_COLOR = "#888888"   # Grey
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Display the formal FTC formula: integral from a to b of f(x)dx = F(b) - F(a) in gold (#FFD700).
        self.lecture[0].set_color(GOLD)
        ftc_formula = MathTex(r"\int_a^b f(x)dx =", r"F(b) - F(a)", color=GOLD)
        self.place_in_area(ftc_formula, 'A2', 'A6', scale_factor=0.9)
        self.play(Write(ftc_formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # To integrate, just find the antiderivative.
        # Highlight F(b)-F(a) in the formula
        self.lecture[1].set_color(GOLD)
        surround_rect = SurroundingRectangle(ftc_formula[1], color=GOLD, buff=0.1)
        self.play(Create(surround_rect))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(FadeOut(surround_rect))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Evaluate it at the two boundaries.
        # Show a vertical axis representing altitude F(x) with points F(a) and F(b).
        self.lecture[2].set_color(ALTITUDE_COLOR)
        
        # Vertical axis F(x) in Column 2 (aligned vertically from Row B to F)
        axis_top = self.grid['B2']
        axis_bottom = self.grid['F2']
        axis_line = Line(axis_bottom, axis_top, color=ALTITUDE_COLOR)
        axis_label = MathTex("F(x)", color=ALTITUDE_COLOR, font_size=24).next_to(axis_top, UP, buff=0.1)
        
        # Points F(a) and F(b) on the axis
        # F(a) at E2, F(b) at C2
        dot_a = Dot(self.grid['E2'], color=ALTITUDE_COLOR)
        dot_b = Dot(self.grid['C2'], color=ALTITUDE_COLOR)
        label_a = MathTex("F(a)", color=ALTITUDE_COLOR, font_size=20).next_to(dot_a, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        label_b = MathTex("F(b)", color=ALTITUDE_COLOR, font_size=20).next_to(dot_b, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(Create(axis_line), Write(axis_label))
        self.play(FadeIn(dot_a, label_a), FadeIn(dot_b, label_b))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Subtract the start from the end.
        # Animate a bracket measuring the distance between F(b) and F(a) on the axis.
        self.lecture[3].set_color(GOLD)
        
        # Brace on the right side of the axis (Column 3)
        brace = BraceBetweenPoints(dot_a.get_center(), dot_b.get_center(), direction=RIGHT, color=GOLD)
        brace_label = brace.get_tex("F(b) - F(a)", font_size=24)
        brace_label.set_color(GOLD)
        
        self.play(Create(brace), Write(brace_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # No more complex Riemann sums needed.
        # Connect this distance visually to the total shaded area under the curve f(x).
        # Fade out a complex Riemann sum grid to leave only the simple F(b) - F(a) calculation.
        self.lecture[4].set_color(AREA_COLOR)
        
        # Graph f(x) in Columns 4-6, Rows C-F
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 4, 1],
            y_range=[0, 4, 1],
            x_length=3,
            y_length=3,
            axis_config={"include_tip": False, "font_size": 15}
        )
        # Position axes in the bottom-right quadrant area
        self.place_in_area(axes, 'C4', 'F6', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        curve = axes.get_graph(lambda x: 0.1 * (x - 2)**3 + 0.5 * x + 1, color=CURVE_COLOR)
        curve_label = MathTex("f(x)", color=CURVE_COLOR, font_size=24).next_to(axes, UP, buff=0.1)
        
        # Shaded area representing the integral
        area = axes.get_area(curve, x_range=[1, 3], color=AREA_COLOR, opacity=0.3)
        
        # Riemann sum rectangles to be faded out
        riemann_rects = axes.get_riemann_rectangles(curve, x_range=[1, 3], dx=0.15, color=RIEMANN_COLOR, stroke_width=0.5, fill_opacity=0.5)
        
        self.play(Create(axes), Create(curve), Write(curve_label))
        self.play(FadeIn(riemann_rects))
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Fade out Riemann, show smooth area
        self.play(FadeOut(riemann_rects), FadeIn(area))
        
        # Connect the height difference F(b)-F(a) to the physical area
        connection_line = DashedLine(brace.get_center(), area.get_center(), color=GOLD, stroke_width=2)
        self.play(Create(connection_line))
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup the layout for Section 5
        self.setup_layout(
            "The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus",
            [
                "- Integration measures accumulated area",
                "- Differentiation measures rate of change",
                "- The Inverse Dance: These operations undo",
                "  one another via the FTC.",
                "- Formalizing the link between sums and slopes"
            ]
        )

        # Define the core mathematical concept for this section
        ftc_formula = MathTex(
            r"\frac{d}{dx} \int_{a}^{x} f(t) \, dt = f(x)",
            color=YELLOW
        )

        # Position the formula on the 6x6 right-side grid
        # Placing at 'C3' as it is central in the right-side visual corridor
        self.place_at_grid(ftc_formula, "C3", scale_factor=1.2)

        # Animation sequence
        self.play(
            Write(ftc_formula),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # Highlighting the relationship
        self.play(
            Indicate(ftc_formula, color=BLUE_B, scale_factor=1.1),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        self.wait(2)
